title: Renewal Calendar Collision Week
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=calendar:event category="renewal"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as renewals_due, sum(renewal_amount_usd) as renewal_spend_usd by _time
| where renewals_due>=3
| sort - _time
description: Flags weeks where multiple SaaS renewals bunch together and create a noisy review window.
value: Renewal collisions make it easier to miss price increases and harder to remember whether each tool is still worth it.
implementation: Tag renewal entries in your calendar and roll them up by week with expected spend.
visualization: Weekly column chart of renewal count with a line for spend.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks which weeks pile too many subscription renewals on top of each other.
